title: ProTPAv
description: This project adds ProTPA, an advanced Minecraft teleportation plugin with animated countdowns, TPA/TPAHERE requests, RTP functionality, and death location recovery featuring GUI interfaces and configurable safety features for enhanced server gameplay.
body:
ProTPA - Advanced Minecraft Teleportation Plugin
ProTPA revolutionizes Minecraft teleportation with cutting-edge features and stunning visual effects. This comprehensive plugin brings modern teleportation mechanics to your server, featuring animated countdowns, intuitive GUIs, and robust safety systems.

Key Features
🎯 Advanced Teleportation Commands

/tpa <player> - Request teleport to another player
/tpahere <player> - Bring players to your location
/rtp - Random teleport with intelligent safe location finding
/back - Return to death location within 5 minutes
🎨 Immersive Animations
Experience teleportation like never before with color-coded countdown titles (3§a → 2§e → 1§c), synchronized sound effects with progressive pitch, particle bursts, and real-time action bar updates. All animations are fully configurable.

🖥️ User-Friendly Interfaces
Beautiful GUI systems for accepting/denying requests and selecting RTP worlds with rainbow-colored items. Proper color code conversion ensures consistent display across all interfaces.

🛡️ Safety & Security
Advanced protection systems including movement cancellation, combat detection, cooldown management, and granular permissions. The RTP system uses sophisticated algorithms to find safe landing spots.

⚙️ Highly Configurable
YAML-based configuration with extensive customization options for delays, sounds, particles, messages, and animations. Full localization support and toggle systems for player preferences.

🔧 Technical Excellence
Built for Paper API 1.20+ with optimized performance, event-driven architecture, and comprehensive error handling. Compatible with Paper, Purpur, Pufferfish, Spigot, and Bukkit servers.
